meta.title: EvoOntology semantic layer
meta.description: Gives this agent a self-evolving, versioned ontology over a database, ported from ruc-datalab/EvoOntology. Activating the bundle registers three skills (build-ontology, evolve-ontology, explore-ontology) and connects one local stdio MCP server that exposes 29 `mcp__evo__*` tools. The ontology records terms, field mappings, relations, constraints and evidence, so a question is grounded in the real schema instead of guessed. Building or evolving a layer runs real queries against a workspace `.evoontology/` directory and writes files there; nothing is sent off the machine. Needs Python 3.10+ available as `python` on PATH, or set `DSH_EVOONTOLOGY_PYTHON` to an interpreter. The vendored Python core is copied to `$DSH_HOME/evoontology/python` when the bundle activates, and the tools may need a DSH restart before they appear. Turning the bundle off removes the skills and tools; staged files stay until you delete them.
